component.name: lwip-core
component.description: lwIP core as built for Phoenix-RTOS (lib-lwip submodule)

properties.name: scope
properties.value: Third-party code vendored by this component only. Meant to be merged into a product-level SBOM, not scanned on its own.

pedigree.notes: STABLE-2_1_2_RELEASE (159e31b6) plus 52 commits on branch STABLE-2_1_x_phoenix: cherry-picks from upstream STABLE-2_1 and Phoenix changes (packet sockets, IPsec hooks, ioctl interface). STABLE-2_1_3_RELEASE is NOT merged: about 30 of its fixes are missing, including 'icmp6: Don't copy too much data' (CVE-2020-22283) and 'tcp: Fix double free in tcp_split_unsent_seg()'. Match advisories against 2.1.2; for fixes identified by commit, check whether the commit is an ancestor of the pinned fork commit.

properties.name: source
properties.value: lib-lwip submodule; built from LWIPNOAPPSFILES in src/Filelists.mk minus netif/slipif.c. G3 builds additionally drop netif/lowpan6.c and netif/lowpan6_common.c (replaced by g3/, see g3/sbom.json). src/apps (httpd, mqtt, snmp, mdns, sntp, smtp, tftp, ...) is not built.

properties.name: configuration
properties.value: include/default-opts/lwipopts.h: LWIP_IPV6 is not enabled, so IPv6, 6LoWPAN and zepif sources compile to nothing; PPP with PAP, CHAP and MSCHAP is enabled. G3 builds use include/default-opts/g3/lwipopts.h, which enables LWIP_IPV6.

properties.name: maintenance
properties.value: The purl pins the lib-lwip submodule commit. Update it whenever the submodule is bumped, and update version, cpe and pedigree if the upstream base changes (e.g. after merging STABLE-2_1_3_RELEASE).

components.name: polarssl
components.description: MD4, MD5, SHA-1 and DES primitives bundled with lwIP for PPP authentication (CHAP, MSCHAP)

supplier.name: PolarSSL (Paul Bakker), based on XySSL (Christophe Devine)

properties.name: source
properties.value: lib-lwip/src/netif/ppp/polarssl/{md4,md5,sha1,des}.c, compiled in because CHAP_SUPPORT and MSCHAP_SUPPORT are enabled without an external crypto library. arc4.c is present but compiles to nothing (MPPE_SUPPORT is off).

properties.name: note
properties.value: Upstream version unknown (2009-era PolarSSL, trimmed by lwIP). No CPE on purpose: the polarssl CPE matches TLS, bignum and RSA advisories for code that is not present, and defects in this copy are filed against lwIP, whose CPE covers it.
